wookieepedia_title: Maximilian Veers' giant B1 Battle droid
description: Maxmilian Veers' giant B1 Battle droid was a droid created by Maximilian Veers in the Geonosian droid factories on the planet Geonosis to destroy the Millennium Falcon until it was destroyed by Gial Ackbar in Daisy Mae.
